questions.question: Can I get a refund if I change my mind?
questions.answer: Yes, you can get a refund within 14 days of payment if you have not used the bot's services.

questions.question: What additional features are planned?
questions.answer: In the future, we plan to integrate service centers and auto shops, track fuel expenses, and allow users to check and pay fines directly through the bot.

questions.question: How does the bot work?
questions.answer: You add your car to the My Garage section. The bot creates a maintenance schedule and sends reminders when it's time to change the oil or pass a vehicle inspection.
